requirements.text: Keep immutable segment keys and signed manifest authorization separate from routing.
Fail over unhealthy regions without directing traffic to an unready origin.
Bound peer waiting and preserve a CDN fallback before playback deadline.

problem.scope: Extend L010 playback with regional CDN selection, origin shields and region-failure policy. Compare multi-CDN steering and bounded peer-assisted regional delivery. Segment identity/integrity and playback deadline remain explicit.
